author: Chang Cheng
boundary_policy: Report all training-CV boundary selections; do not change the grid after validation. Fixed-budget evidence does not establish tuning optimality.
official_test_policy: Do not download or evaluate official test data in this development runner.

cross_dataset_decision.role: Prospective external-data four-solver comparison plus a matched retuned CelebA block; historical CelebA outcomes already known. Numerical implementation amended after partial training CV and before external development validation; decision rule unchanged.
cross_dataset_decision.eligibility: Every declared selected NMF case and all three profiles valid, converged, warning-free, and exact label/probability reproduction; no omitted unsuccessful cases.
cross_dataset_decision.weighting: Equal dataset weight; equal task weight within each dataset; equal size-seed case weight within each task.
cross_dataset_decision.accuracy_reference: Best eligible absolute-screening solver among all four at each corresponding aggregation level.
cross_dataset_decision.primary_case_cost: Median of three serial (total fit plus joint labels/probabilities prediction) sums, using each dataset's fixed validation batch (CelebA 4000, Fashion-MNIST 2000).
cross_dataset_decision.cost_aggregation: Divide each case cost by the fastest eligible solver on that same case; weighted geometric mean with the same dataset/task/case weights.
cross_dataset_decision.tie_rule: Among accuracy-qualified methods within 5% of minimum weighted cost: higher global balanced accuracy, then lower weighted cost, then CD, SPA, MU, ANLS-BPP in this order for an exact tie. Numerical comparisons use absolute slack 1e-12.
cross_dataset_decision.no_accuracy_qualified_method: Select minimum maximum normalized global/dataset/task regret; then lower weighted cost; report the unresolved accuracy conflict prominently.
cross_dataset_decision.no_eligible_method: Do not finalize the default; retain numerical failures and diagnose separately.

sensitivities.tuning_cost: Report CV wall and aggregate compute separately; add aggregate per-job CV compute to serial deployment cost as a labeled secondary sensitivity, not the primary workload.

cross_dataset_decision.historical_celeba_role: Earlier CD/SPA decision and amendment are preserved context and sensitivity only; no imputation of missing MU/BPP cases into the primary four-solver comparison.

supersedes: examples/fashion_mnist_solver_protocol_v2.json; numerical repair before any new development-validation evaluation
execution_order: Fashion-MNIST serial development validation and profiling
Matched CelebA serial development validation and profiling
anls_numerical_policy: Float64 NNDSVDa ANLS-BPP; at most 1000 outer NNLS sweeps; inner cap max(100,5*rank), relative KKT tolerance 1e-10 plus explicit roundoff allowance 256*float64_epsilon*max(NNLS design shape); outer relative initial projected-gradient tolerance 1e-4; no factor rescaling. Every inner/outer failure warns and invalidates. Iteration counts and tolerances are algorithm-specific and not equal optimization error. Ill-conditioned passive sets use the direct low-level LAPACK DGELSD wrapper, with explicit float64-epsilon rank cutoff and checked workspace/info; the high-level scipy.linalg.lstsq batched dispatcher is bypassed as a disclosed crash workaround.

numerical_repair.author: Chang Cheng
numerical_repair.reason: Repeated Windows native access violation in scipy.linalg.lstsq -> _batched_linalg._lstsq during ANLS-BPP original-design passive-set least squares.
numerical_repair.implementation_change: Call SciPy's low-level LAPACK DGELSD wrapper directly, preserving the original-design minimum-norm least-squares problem and float64-epsilon rank cutoff; validate workspaces and LAPACK status. Avoid the high-level batched lstsq dispatch.
numerical_repair.unchanged: Data, preprocessing, folds, predictive grids, NMF objective, NNDSVDa initialization, NNLS/KKT tolerances, iteration caps, factor geometry, metrics, and default-selection rule.
numerical_repair.receipt_policy: Copy only unchanged non-BPP calibration chunks and committed folds byte-for-byte after strict identity verification; retain source hashes and lineage. Rerun every ANLS-BPP chunk. Preserve all original results, including failures, as historical evidence.

anls_passive_lstsq_backend: scipy.linalg.lapack.dgelsd with explicit workspace query; original-design float64 minimum-norm solve
